mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate liraglutide's glucose-lowering effects and increase serotonergic activity, while liraglutide's effects on gastric motility and appetite may be unpredictably altered by MAOI activity.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; consider alternative antidepressant; educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms; dose adjustment of liraglutide may be necessary.
